description.value: Mary Brown's is a 100% Canadian-owned fast food chain specializing in fresh, hand-cut and hand-breaded chicken and scratch-made Taters from whole Canadian-grown potatoes. This Kamloops location sits on Tranquille Road in a commercial building with drive-through service, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the North Shore area.
